meetings.detail: CONFIRMS a claim the execution plan flagged as doubtful. fomcexecutionplan.md sec 4 warned: 'The ChatGPT document reported July as 9-3 with three preferring a hike; that does not match other reporting.' The primary source says exactly that. Three voting presidents preferred a 25bp HIKE. Their April dissent was on easing-bias language; by July they had escalated to wanting a hike. That escalation is the single strongest dissent signal in the 2026 record.
